Messages.Author: freakdrivr
Messages.Body:
Hey,

first off - GREAT rulebook for the Anarchs... it's the clearest
ever... However, i still need clarification on when the Reacting
minion in a combat can play Terror Frenzy: can it be played after the
acting Methuselah decides to not play any more before range cards? or
can it be played immediately after the acting Methuselah's first
before range card?

my interpretation is after the acting Methuselah has decided to not
play anymore before range cards - even though s/he mya respond with
some more cards playable before range after the Terror Frenzy is
played by the reacting Methuselah.

thanks,

may the funk be with you

jds
